controls.representation: fixed canonical quadratic energy, no mutable implementation choice

decision_rules.conservation: calibrated tolerance is the smallest 1e-3 multiple >= 1.25 times held-out dt=.04 drift; old threshold status uses that fixed value
decision_rules.convergence: dt=.04 drift must be <= dt=.08 drift and dt=.02 drift <= dt=.04 drift for every frozen conservative control
decision_rules.work: VALIDATED only if all force-free work residuals <= 1e-14 and conservative-potential drift is no greater than matching source-free drift plus 1e-12

energy_identity: For force-free controls Delta K equals cumulative half-kick work exactly; for harmonic controls residual after cumulative source work is compared against the matching source-free integrator drift, never against one-step work alone.

old_gates.virtual_work: abs(full-run energy change minus one-step work)/abs(one-step work) <= 1e-5

work_definition: At every source half-kick p->p+(dt/2)S, discrete work is K(p_after)-K(p_before). Cumulative work sums every source half-kick on exactly the executed temporal support. A fixed source potential is included as -S dot u in total energy.
